settings.visualStyle: AI-generated historical reenactment styled as black-and-white 35mm Bastogne December 1944 wartime newsreel footage. Snow foxholes, bare trees, freezing fog, U.S. winter field gear, M1 helmets and rifles. Moderate grain, gate weave, scratches, dust, flicker, soft optics and imperfect exposure. Non-graphic combat only. No modern objects, HDR, drone, gimbal, glossy lighting or game-like framing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 connected scenes x 8 seconds. A human wartime cameraman is physically embedded with U.S. defenders around Bastogne. He shares frozen foxholes, walks through deep snow, crouches behind trees, enters the same tiny shelter, reacts late to artillery, gets snow on the lens and cannot hold impossible exposed positions. No dialogue, narration, subtitles or music. Diegetic sound only.
settings.customVisualStyle: Human-operated winter siege field-camera realism: snow crunch and slipping footwork, lens snow flecks, breath haze, cold-hand tremor, low foxhole angles, fog-softened focus, impact shake and long near-still holds during quiet defensive waiting.

archivalLookLock.audioPolicy: No music, narration or intelligible dialogue. Diegetic sound only.

movie.plotDetails: A fictional U.S. defender anchors continuity while the cameraman physically shares the perimeter positions.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a two-minute Bastogne 1944 reenactment as if a human wartime correspondent were physically filming from inside the U.S. defensive perimeter. Camera must obey snow depth, fog, foxholes, tree cover, artillery and human reaction time. Follow frozen foxhole, quiet woods, artillery burst, brief return fire, movement between positions, tiny shelter, ammunition check, dusk patrol, night hold and another frozen morning. Black-and-white 35mm newsreel treatment. No dialogue, narration or music. Non-graphic and period accurate.
movie.storySummary: A U.S. defender holds a frozen foxhole, moves through quiet woods, endures artillery, briefly fires back, warms his hands in a crude shelter, checks ammunition, survives another barrage and remains on the line through dusk, night and dawn. The cameraman shares the same cold and cover throughout.
movie.storyTitle: WWII FRONTLINE FOOTAGE EP09 — Bastogne 1944: Surrounded in Snow

scenes.title: Frozen Foxhole
scenes.description: A defender peers from a snow-lined foxhole at first light.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rubs gloved hands and raises his head above edge.
scenes.imageDescription: Bastogne December 1944, snowy foxhole, bare trees, U.S. winter gear, breath vapor, monochrome 35mm grain.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman is crouched inside the same foxhole, chest-height only; trench wall blocks lower frame and operator’s breath briefly hazes lens. Small cold-hand tremor. Audio: wind, breath, snow creak, distant artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains in foxhole as soldier prepares perimeter check.

scenes.title: Quiet Woods
scenes.description: The defender moves between bare trees.
scenes.actionDescription: He walks through deep snow scanning foggy treeline.
scenes.imageDescription: Sparse snow forest, fog, U.S. defender with rifle low.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator follows two steps behind, deep snow causes slow heavy bounce and small slips; trunks repeatedly block view. No smooth tracking. Audio: snow crunch, wind, gear, low rumble.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator returns toward foxholes with soldier.

scenes.title: Artillery Breaks the Silence
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops back into foxhole as snow showers down.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow plumes beyond foxholes, defenders low, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator reacts late to first boom and dives after soldier; frame hits trench wall, snow fills lens briefly, sound dulls, then camera recovers low. Audio: artillery booms, debris, muffled hearing, breath.

scenes.title: Hold the Edge
scenes.description: Defenders answer briefly from the line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier fires controlled shots toward distant treeline.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow foxhole firing position, dark trees distant, no mixed enemy nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman stays below parapet and raises lens only with soldier; helmet and snow lip block portions of view. He ducks immediately after short firing beat. Audio: rifle shots, wind, distant answering fire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera low as squad prepares shift.

scenes.title: Move Between Positions
scenes.description: A section shifts along forest edge.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier crouch-runs between tree clusters.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow forest movement, fog, disturbed snow, U.S. defenders.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator follows last, tree trunks and backs constantly occlude lens; one slip makes frame cant and drop before recovery behind next tree. Audio: boots, gear, distant gunfire.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera arrives behind tree cover with group.

scenes.title: A Tiny Shelter
scenes.description: The soldier pauses in crude rear shelter.
scenes.actionDescription: He cups hands near tiny heat source.
scenes.imageDescription: Improvised shelter, tarps, crates, dim practical light, melting snow on sleeves.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman squeezes inside behind him; walls and hanging tarp keep frame tight. Near-still view with slight breath movement, exposure slowly adjusts from snow brightness to dim shelter. Audio: small fire, wind outside, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator follows soldier back toward doorway.

scenes.title: Back Into the Cold
scenes.description: The pause ends and soldier returns to line.
scenes.actionDescription: He steps from shelter into windblown snow and descends foxhole.
scenes.imageDescription: Transition from dim shelter to bright snow, same accumulated damp gear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator exits behind him; bright snow briefly overexposes, wind buffets camera, then lens drops with soldier into trench. Audio: wind rises, boots, gear.

scenes.title: Watch the Treeline
scenes.description: Fog makes distant movement hard to read.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier scans left to right without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: Foggy snow forest, defender half concealed by tree, no enemy required.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman crouches behind neighboring trunk; view is narrow and branch-obscured. Slow human pan follows soldier’s gaze with focus breathing in fog. Audio: wind, branch creak, distant engine/artillery.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera stays behind tree as soldier returns to foxhole.

scenes.title: Ammunition Count
scenes.description: Limited supplies make every cartridge matter.
scenes.imageDescription: Gloved hands checking ammunition in snowy foxhole, rifle resting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator films from inches away in cramped trench; nearby sleeve and pouch fill much of frame, cold tremor visible, no polished macro move. Audio: fabric, metal, breath, distant shelling.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera rises slightly as another barrage begins.

scenes.title: Second Barrage
scenes.description: Another artillery burst shakes same position.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier braces against frozen wall.
scenes.imageDescription: Frozen foxhole, snow and earth falling, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator is trapped in foxhole; heavy shock shakes frame, camera knocks against wall, snow covers part of lens and sound goes dull before slow recovery. Audio: artillery, debris, ringing-like dullness, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains low as barrage eases.

scenes.title: Reinforce the Woods
scenes.description: The section moves through trees after barrage.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier advances to new shallow position.
scenes.imageDescription: Snowy woods, disturbed snow, tired defenders, grey sky.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows at tired walking pace behind the unit, not beside it; boot holes guide his path and occasional branch hits lens edge. Audio: snow, gear, distant fire, wind.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Operator stops at new fighting position.

scenes.title: Blue Dusk Patrol
scenes.description: The woods become blue and indistinct as daylight fades.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks slowly and stops to listen.
scenes.imageDescription: Blue-hour winter forest, fog, visible breath.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator stays two steps behind; low light causes focus hunting and slight exposure pumping, breath haze crosses lens. He stops a half-beat after soldier. Audio: wind, snow crunch, very distant combat.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera returns to foxhole for night.

scenes.title: Night Hold
scenes.description: Darkness settles while distant flashes mark horizon.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier sits low with rifle across knees.
scenes.imageDescription: Night foxhole, dark trees, distant flashes, breath vapor.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera sits low beside him, almost still except cold-hand tremor; exposure changes imperfectly with distant flashes. No clean night panorama. Audio: wind, far artillery, breath.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Camera remains in same foxhole until dawn.

scenes.title: Another Frozen Morning
scenes.description: Pale morning returns over same defensive line.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises stiffly and brushes fresh snow away.
scenes.imageDescription: Same foxhole geometry, more churned snow, exhausted defender rising.
scenes.videoPrompt: Operator rises slowly from cramped crouch; frame wobbles with stiff movement and points briefly at snow wall before leveling. Audio: fabric, snow, breath, distant guns.

scenes.title: Still Holding
scenes.description: The defensive line remains beneath cold white sky.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier walks past tired defenders and disappears among trees.
scenes.imageDescription: Snow forest perimeter, foxholes and tired defenders, no celebration.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cameraman follows a few paces then stops behind a tree for cover; holds human-height view as soldier disappears through fog, trunk occupying part of frame. No aerial pull-back. Audio: snow steps, wind, distant artillery only.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Final frame is foggy tree line and quiet foxholes.

continuity.continuityRules: Same face, helmet, rifle and winter clothing. Snow, moisture and exhaustion accumulate; no clean reset.
